Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area

Source: R/fao_report.R
fao_report.Rd

This function runs the analyses of the package for one FAO major fishing area and writes a Word report in Chinese or English: cover, title, abstract, data sources and methods, results and conclusions with charts and tables, references and appendix tables. The text is written from templates filled in with the results, as a first draft: check it, and complete the parts marked in grey, such as other data sources, the discussion and other references.

Usage

fao_report(
  area,
  ...,
  file = NULL,
  format = "docx",
  lang = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  report_no = 1,
  author = NULL,
  affiliation = NULL,
  project = NULL,
  date = Sys.Date(),
  font = NULL,
  font_zh = "FangSong",
  citation = c("apa", "fao"),
  top_n = 10,
  data_version = "latest",
  total = TRUE,
  species = TRUE,
  countries = TRUE,
  groups = TRUE,
  status = TRUE,
  quality = TRUE,
  diversity = TRUE,
  fleets = TRUE,
  shocks = FALSE,
  collapse = FALSE,
  synchrony = FALSE,
  pelagic = FALSE,
  mtc = FALSE,
  distant = FALSE,
  cmsy = FALSE
)

Arguments

area

The FAO major fishing area: its name, e.g. "Atlantic, Eastern Central", or its code, e.g. 34.

...

Settings of the analyses, named with the section as prefix: total_ for fishing_area_data(), species_ for fishing_area_species(), countries_ for fishing_area_country(), groups_ for species_group_composition(), status_ for stock_status(), quality_ for data_quality(), diversity_ for diversity_concentration(), fleets_ for coastal_distant(), shocks_ for catch_shocks(), collapse_ for collapse_analysis() (and collapse_seed, the seed of its random series, default 1), synchrony_ for catch_synchrony(), pelagic_ for pelagic_demersal(), mtc_ for mean_temperature_catch() (the report uses mtc_version = "builtin", the FishBase data bundled with the package, unless another version is given), distant_ for distant_water_profile() (and distant_countries, the number of distant-water countries profiled, default 3, or their names) and cmsy_ for cmsy_area() (and cmsy_input()). For example species_h_value = 0.2, countries_line_linewidth = 1, status_smooth = TRUE, cmsy_top = 5 or cmsy_settings = list(n.iter = 100000). A name that is not an argument of the function gives an error listing its arguments. The arguments the report sets itself (area_data, area_name, area, lang, table and pptx) cannot be changed, nor can pelagic_by and mtc_by (the analyses by division use the data of load_fao_divisions(), an extension that is not part of the report).

file

The file to write. Default is reports/FAO<code>_report_<lang>.docx in the working directory. The other formats get the same name with .tex and .pdf.

format

The formats to write, one or more of "docx" (default: Word), "latex" (a .tex file with its figures in the folder <name>_figures/ next to it, compiled with XeLaTeX; Chinese reports use the ctexart class) and "pdf" (the LaTeX file compiled to PDF with XeLaTeX, through the tinytex package when it is installed, which also installs missing LaTeX packages). Install TinyTeX once with install.packages("tinytex") and tinytex::install_tinytex(); an old TinyTeX is updated with tinytex::reinstall_tinytex(). The analyses run once for all formats, and the formats have the same text, figures, tables and references. Fonts are taken from those of the computer: for Chinese, FangSong, SimHei and KaiTi on Windows, STFangsong, Heiti SC and Kaiti SC on macOS, else the Fandol fonts of TeX Live.

lang

The language of the report: "zh" (Chinese) or "en" (English). Default is NULL, the language set with fao_settings() ("both" gives a Chinese report).

title

The report title. Default is generated from the area, e.g. "Assessment of Marine Capture Production in FAO Major Fishing Area 34 (Atlantic, Eastern Central)".

report_no

The number of the report, shown as "Report 1" (in Chinese reports with a Chinese numeral) and used in the figure and table numbers (1-1, 1-2, ...). Default is 1.

author

The author on the cover and below the title. Default is NULL, which writes "Author" ("作者" in Chinese reports) as a placeholder.

affiliation

The affiliation on the cover. Default is NULL, none.

project

The text at the top of the cover. Default is NULL, which writes "Project Report" ("课题报告" in Chinese reports).

date

The date on the cover. Default is today.

font

The font of the text in Latin script. Default is "Times New Roman" in Chinese reports and "Arial" in English reports.

font_zh

The font of the Chinese body text. Default is "FangSong".

citation

The citation style of English reports: "apa" (default) or "fao" (the style of FAO publications). Chinese reports use numbered citations (GB/T 7714).

top_n

The number of main species and countries in the charts and tables, and of species assessed with CMSY++ (unless cmsy_top is given). Default is 10.

data_version

The FAO release to use, as in load_fao_data(). Default is "latest".

total, species, countries, groups, status, quality, diversity, fleets

Logical values: whether the report has the section on the total catch and its stages (fishing_area_data()), the main species (fishing_area_species()), the main fishing countries (fishing_area_country()), the ISSCAAP groups (species_group_composition()), the stock status plots (stock_status()), the data quality (data_quality()), the diversity and concentration of the catch (diversity_concentration()) and the coastal and distant-water fleets (coastal_distant()). All TRUE by default.

shocks, collapse, synchrony, pelagic, mtc, distant

Logical values: whether the report has the sections on catch shocks (catch_shocks()), fishery collapses (collapse_analysis()), the synchrony of the catch and the portfolio effect (catch_synchrony()), the pelagic to demersal ratio (pelagic_demersal()), the mean temperature of the catch (mean_temperature_catch()) and the profiles of the main distant-water fleets in the area (distant_water_profile()). All FALSE by default.

cmsy

A logical value. If TRUE, the main species are also assessed with CMSY++ (cmsy_area()), and the report has a part on the assessment, with the results of every species and appendix tables of the reference points, priors and their sources. Default is FALSE. The result of an earlier cmsy_area() run can also be given, to write the report without running CMSY++ again. CMSY++ needs JAGS: see cmsy_setup().

Value

Invisibly, a list of class fao_report with the paths of the files written (file, named by format: docx, latex, pdf), the sections in the report (sections) and the tables of the report as data frames: main_species and main_countries, the species of the mean temperature of the catch with their FishBase matches (mtc_species), the results of all analyses (analyses), and with CMSY++ cmsy_reference_points (r, k, MSY, Fmsy, Bmsy, B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy with 95% confidence limits), cmsy_priors (resilience, r, k and B/k priors, their sources and the links to FishBase or SeaLifeBase, the FishBase data, the CMSY++ code and the FAO data) and the full CMSY++ result cmsy. Assign it, e.g. report <- fao_report(...), to look at the tables (View(report$cmsy_priors)). With cmsy = TRUE, all CMSY++ results (runs, charts and tables) are kept in the folder cmsy/ next to the report, with cmsy_result.rds to write the report again without running CMSY++ (cmsy = readRDS("cmsy/<area>/cmsy_result.rds")).

Details

Every analysis is a section that can be switched on or off (total, species, ..., cmsy). The settings of the function of a section are given with the section name as prefix, e.g. species_h_value = 0.2 is h_value = 0.2 of fishing_area_species() and cmsy_top = 5 is top = 5 of cmsy_area(). The abstract, the methods, the conclusions and the references follow the sections that are switched on.

Chinese reports follow the format of project reports: A4 pages; body text in FangSong and Times New Roman, size 12 (xiao si), 1.5 line spacing and a first-line indent of two characters; title in bold FangSong, size 18; "abstract" in SimHei, size 15; section headings in SimHei and subsection headings in KaiTi, size 14; captions in SimHei, size 12, numbered by report (figure 1-1, table 1-1), below figures and above tables; three-line tables with text in FangSong, size 10.5; numbered references in superscript square brackets, in the order of citation (GB/T 7714). English reports have the same structure, in one font (Arial by default), with author-date citations in APA style or in the style of FAO publications. Scientific names of species and genera are in italics.

The text templates are in inst/extdata/report_text.csv and the references in inst/extdata/report_references.csv of the package source: edit them to change the wording.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fao_report(34)                                  # Chinese or English, from fao_settings()
fao_report("Atlantic, Eastern Central", lang = "zh", author = "Hongyu Lin")
fao_report(34, lang = "en", font = "Times New Roman", citation = "fao")

# The other analyses of the package, with their settings
fao_report(34, lang = "zh", shocks = TRUE, collapse = TRUE, synchrony = TRUE, pelagic = TRUE,
           mtc = TRUE, distant = TRUE, collapse_method = "worm2006", distant_countries = 5)

# Only some sections, with settings of their functions
fao_report(34, lang = "zh", quality = FALSE, diversity = FALSE,
           species_h_value = 0.2, status_smooth = TRUE)

# With a CMSY++ assessment of the 10 main species (a few minutes)
report <- fao_report(34, lang = "zh", cmsy = TRUE)
report                                         # the tables it returns
View(report$cmsy_reference_points)             # r, k, MSY, B/Bmsy, ... with 95% limits
View(report$cmsy_priors)                       # priors, sources and links
fao_report(34, lang = "zh", top_n = 15, cmsy = TRUE, cmsy_top = 5)

# Reuse CMSY++ results to rewrite the report
fao_report(34, lang = "zh", cmsy = readRDS(file.path("reports", "cmsy", "Atlantic__Eastern_Central",
                                                      "cmsy_result.rds")))
} # }
